subject: Launch request: Deployment & Reliability Product Manager — requisition + interview plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Launch request: Deployment & Reliability Product Manager — requisition + interview plan

Hi all,

Requesting sign-off to launch a new headcount: Deployment & Reliability Product Manager (IC4 / senior PM) to own model-serving reliability, rollout orchestration, and cost-performance tradeoffs. This is a net-new req tied to our Dedicated + Private product roadmap (Q2 feature set) and to support the Platform team's SLA commitments.

Why now:
- Increased Dedicated customer commitments need a PM to own SLAs and cross-team ops (infra, SRE, product)
- We have several infra and API changes planned in Q2 that require product-level prioritization and customer-facing runbooks
- Recruiting window to onboard by mid-Q2: we need to open the req this week to hit schedule

Proposed details (high-level):
- Level: Senior PM (IC4) — target comp band: 170–200k base + equity; hiring manager: Marcus Lin
- Team: Platform (serving/runtime) — reports to Marissa
- Req code / budget: headcount bucket 2027-PLAT-03 (confirmed with Finance)
- Interview loop (proposed): 1) Recruiter screen, 2) Tech/product deep dive (serving & reliability), 3) Cross-functional partner panel (SRE + CS), 4) Exec final (optional)

Attachments: JD_Deployment_PM_v2.pdf, interview_slate_v1.xlsx (proposed panel + slots).

Asks:
1) Approve opening the req (budget code above)
2) Approve the proposed interview slate or suggest edits (we should keep loop tight — aim for 3–4 stages max)
3) Give go-ahead to engage Greenfield Recruiting (Sarah) for immediate sourcing (I've cc'd Sarah on a separate mail).

If we can get approvals by EOD tomorrow I will instruct HR/Recruiting to post and schedule an initial recruiter calibration.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform — Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachment: JD_Deployment_PM_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
Attachment: interview_slate_v1.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch request: Deployment & Reliability Product Manager — requisition + interview plan

Thanks Marcus — quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) Level confirmation: is IC4 the bar for candidates who will own cross-org priorities right away, or do you want IC5? I want to make sure we align comp and expectations.
2) Urgency: is mid-Q2 hard deadline (customer SLA) or a stretch target? If hard, we should authorize a recruiter retainer to speed sourcing.
3) Interview content: can we combine the "tech/product deep dive" and "cross-functional panel" into a single 75–90 minute on-site to reduce cycle time? I worry about multi-step drop-off.

If IC4 and mid-Q2: I can approve the posting subject to merging rounds 2 and 3 into a single panel (product + reliability + SRE). Please confirm and I'll update the posting language and budget approval.

-Marissa
VP, Product — Redwood Inference

Agree with Marissa's suggestion to tighten the loop. A single combined panel (tech + partners) will reduce time-to-offer and give us better cross-functional signal. A couple of additions:

- Include a short take-home case (2–3 hours) focused on runbook design and deployment rollback strategy. That will help differentiate PM candidates with product + operational experience.
- Add a CS stakeholder (Hannah) on the panel to assess customer-facing prioritization skills.
- If we push for mid-Q2 onboarding, we should authorize Greenfield to run an active search with a 6-week timeline. Sarah has a good track record for platform roles.

I approve opening the req with the merged loop and the take-home case added. Marcus — please update the JD to include the take-home and send back; I'll give final sign-off once the JD is updated.

Laura
Head of People Operations — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses — summary / decisions below: 

- Level: stick with IC4. We need a strong senior PM who can run programs end-to-end; IC5 would be overkill for scope and budget.
- Timeline: mid-Q2 is firm for customer deliverables. Please approve a 6-week active search with Greenfield (no retainer; standard contingency).
- Interview loop: merge rounds 2+3 into a single 90-minute panel. Add a 2–3 hour take-home case focused on runbook & rollback strategy (administered between recruiter screen and panel).

Actions I will take now:
- Update JD to call out the take-home and merged panel, then re-upload (see link below).
- Create the Greenhouse job and tag with budget code 2027-PLAT-03 (posting will be ready once Laura re-approves final JD).
- Ask Recruiting to schedule a calibration call with Sarah (Greenfield) for tomorrow.

Laura — thanks for the sign-off. Marissa — tagging you to confirm approval to proceed with the active search cadence. Hannah — please confirm your availability for panel interview slots on weekdays 10am–1pm PST for the next 6 weeks.

If we have confirmation by EOD today I will post and kick the pipeline off.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Platform — Redwood Inference
